result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, **I'd recommend Help Scout as the best overall help desk software** for most businesses.

It's relatively easy to set up, has a shared inbox for team collaboration, customer history, automation, and a knowledge base without the complexity of enterprise-level platforms.

However, the best choice depends on your ticket volume, team size, budget, and whether you primarily support customers through email, live chat, or multiple channels.

## Best help desk platforms compared

Here are the five I'd shortlist in 2026\:

![Help Scout Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vc4OfpksDG0SYFQO2E4DBpLJOQUw-u5-79PbQ0FAzOhtZzreG-oym8CqN3NjPdhGdB9thM6s19ul7-oCFNRzT3e41X5EcsNhFO6CSeSVnQFxwuN5lbEVYZwGfBuSEovHpvvj_dafp0K7DuHOnDsBXe2D-P9xjZT98_6jjWq8rmebpqXoOtAcpGFSu_5ylm1p?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall for small teams)

- Clean, simple interface
- Shared inbox and customer history
- Knowledge base and automation
- Free plan for up to 5 users; paid from \$25/user/month annually

Best for email-first customer support.

(Best all-round ticketing)

- Automation and prioritization

Best for teams handling increasing ticket volumes.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

- Affordable ticket management
- Multi-channel support
- Good automation capabilities
- Free plan for up to 3 agents; paid plans from \$7/user/month annually

Best for budget-conscious businesses.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

- Extensive integrations
- Advanced workflows and routing
- Powerful analytics
- Entry support plan from \$19/agent/month annually

Best for teams expecting significant growth and complexity.

**5\. Intercom**

- Excellent live chat
- AI customer support agent
- In-app messaging
- Automation and customer engagement

Best for SaaS companies and chat-first support teams.

[Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)
